reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs support the conclusion: fees are limited to a one-time license fee (4.1), annual maintenance fees that continue only if Corio elects to keep paying (4.2), and a revenue share computed on actual Application Management Revenue received (p0157) — no floor, guaranteed minimum, or shortfall penalty on the Customer.

Exhibit B shows Software Users as 'Unlimited' (p0151), so there is no volume cap on our usage; the '40 Authorized Software Users per Customer' language in p0158 is correctly read as a qualifying threshold for the revenue-share exemption rather than a purchase obligation.

Ancillary points (five-year term, non-binding Exhibit D marketing targets, mutual audit true-up in 4.4) are appropriately noted in the rationale rather than flagged, consistent with the playbook's treatment of minor sub-elements and other rules' subject matter.
No deterministic check failures and no over-flagging risk since nothing was redlined.
